title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!

About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.

About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics

Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices

Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement

title: Desenvolvedor Front End Angular - Mobile
description:
Código da vaga: 56528

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

O profissional irá atuar com Angular no App, passando por todo ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde o levantamento de requisitos até a implantação dos projetos, apoiando na construção de produtos.

Responsabilidades:

Experiência em Angular15+;

Conhecimento em Module Federation e WebView;

Proficiência em Jest/Jasmine para testes unitários;

Conhecimento em Git/Github;

Conhecimento em Testes de Acessibilidade;

Conhecimento de IDS/Design System;

Conhecimento de Docker;

Experiência em serviços AWS, incluindo CI/CD, S3, ECS, API Gateway, Lambda, Load Balancer e CloudFormation;

Conhecimento em Terraform para criação e gerenciamento de infraestrutura;

CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

  • Domínio de sistemas e ferramentas de gestão da qualidade;

  • Pacote Office avançado.

title: Assessor(a) de Pós-Venda & Experiência do Cliente
description:
Presencial | São Paulo | CLT

A Afetto Design é uma startup do setor moveleiro em crescimento exponencial, criada para ir além do óbvio. Somos uma marca autoral de mobiliário infantil de alto padrão, reconhecida por desenvolver peças que atravessam fases, unem estética, funcionalidade e segurança, e entregam cuidado em cada detalhe, do design à experiência final do cliente.

Desde o início, nossa ambição sempre foi clara: mudar a lógica do mercado, elevar o padrão de qualidade e nos tornar top of mind no segmento. Em menos de dois anos de vida, já estamos entre as 5 maiores marcas do nosso mercado, resultado de visão estratégica, consistência e excelência na execução.

Esse crescimento é reflexo de inovação constante, cliente no centro das decisões, processos bem estruturados e produtos altamente desejados. Mas, acima de tudo, é sustentado por pessoas que entendem que pós-venda não é suporte, é reputação, recorrência e marca.

Sobre a posição | Assessor(a) de Pós-Venda Afetto (B2C)

Buscamos pessoas acima da média, com inteligência relacional, senso de urgência e rigor de execução.

Na Afetto, o pós-venda é parte central da experiência: é onde confiança se consolida, problemas viram solução e clientes viram promotores. Você será responsável por conduzir demandas com clareza, firmeza e empatia, garantindo padrão Afetto em cada contato — e fechando ciclos com excelência.

Aqui, atendimento só é bom quando termina com: cliente bem atendido, caso resolvido e processo melhorado .

Principais Responsabilidades

Conduzir atendimentos de pós-venda B2C (WhatsApp/CRM) com foco em resolução e experiência;

Gerenciar ocorrências de entrega, montagem, avarias e ajustes com organização e senso de prioridade;

Atuar como ponte entre cliente e áreas internas/fornecedores (logística, produção, assistência), garantindo alinhamento e prazos;

title: VAGA ABERTA - TEACHER NA COLLAB ENGLISH SCHOOL
description:
A Collab English School é mais que uma escola de inglês; é um espaço onde acreditamos que falar inglês é uma forma de liberdade.

Aqui, construímos pontes e estendemos relações através da linguagem universal. Valorizamos a autonomia como pilar fundamental para o sucesso profissional, capacitando nossos alunos a alcançarem seus objetivos de carreira de forma confiante e assertiva.

Junte-se a nós e descubra como o inglês pode ser a chave para uma trajetória profissional de sucesso.

Nossa cultura:

A Collab enfatiza a autonomia dos alunos e da equipe, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado flexível e personalizado. A pontualidade é valorizada, reconhecendo o tempo como um recurso valioso. A empatia é cultivada, compartilhando os sonhos dos alunos e criando uma atmosfera acolhedora. Além disso, a escola valoriza os professores como peças-chave para o sucesso, e acredita na simplicidade como abordagem eficaz para o aprendizado do inglês.

Liberdade: Acreditamos que cada um tem o poder de aprender e ensinar do seu jeito. Valorizamos a independência dos alunos e da nossa equipe.

Tempo é precioso: Sabemos que o tempo é um bem valioso. Por isso, ser pontual é uma prioridade. Queremos que todos aproveitem ao máximo cada momento de aprendizado.

Juntos nos seus sonhos: Aqui, nos colocamos no lugar dos alunos e sonhamos junto com eles. Queremos entender suas metas e ajudá-los a realizá-las da melhor forma possível.

Professores são tesouros: Valorizamos profundamente nossos professores. Quando se sentem valorizados, os resultados aparecem para todos.

Descomplicando o inglês: Ensinar e aprender inglês pode (e deve) ser simples. Usamos métodos práticos e eficazes para ajudar nossos alunos a avançar com leveza.

Seus Principais Objetivos:

  • Aulas Virtuais: Planejar e ministrar aulas online, com métodos que mantenham os alunos engajados e coloquem o inglês em prática.
  • Preparação de Materiais Didáticos: Adaptar e criar exercícios, jogos e atividades alinhadas ao perfil dos alunos.
  • Avaliação e Feedback: Avaliar o progresso dos alunos com seriedade e oferecer feedbacks úteis e motivadores.
  • Planejamento de Currículo: Criar planos de aula que desenvolvam todas as habilidades: reading, writing, listening e speaking.
  • Desenvolvimento Profissional: Estar sempre em evolução, participando de formações, cursos, eventos e trocas de conhecimento.
  • Gerenciar sua Própria Agenda: Na Collab, você detém o seu tempo! Organização e pontualidade são essenciais para garantir continuidade no aprendizado.
  • Colaboração Pedagógica: Participar ativamente na criação e execução de estratégias didáticas com foco em resultados.

Procuramos por pessoas com:

  • Raciocínio lógico e visão sistêmica
  • Excelente dicção e comunicação
  • Adaptabilidade e empatia
  • Criatividade e espírito empreendedor
  • Organização e disciplina
  • Resiliência e paciência
  • Proatividade e independência

Requisitos:

  • Ser BILÍNGUE (Inglês e Português): não buscamos fluência, buscamos profundidade no uso da língua.
  • Conhecimento sobre TOEFL e IELTS
  • Postura de mentor, com pensamento analítico e habilidade em gerenciamento de conflitos
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas do Google (docs, sheets, meet, etc) .
  • Ótima comunicação oral e escrita (em inglês e português)
  • Computador e ambiente silencioso para dar aulas

Disponibilidade e Horários

Temos janelas de horários disponíveis para diferentes perfis, com preenchimento gradual de aulas:

  • Turno Tarde/Noite: Segunda a quinta, das 16h às 22h.
  • Turno Manhã: Segunda a quinta, das 07h às 13h.
  • Sábados (Opcional): Das 08h às 13h (apenas para professores com disponibilidade e interesse).

Ponto Obrigatório para Todos: Independentemente do turno , as sextas-feiras, das 10h às 14h, são reservadas para nossas reuniões de equipe, treinamentos e alinhamentos pedagógicos. Sua presença é essencial nesse horário!

title: Engenheiro(a) de Serviços - RJ
description:
Resumo do cargo:

O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.

Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:

1) Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sistemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);

2) Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;

3) Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;

4) Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;

5) Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);

6) Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);

7) Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);

8) Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, assim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;

9) Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.

Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

A Natosafe é pioneira em biometria infantil, comprometidos em preencher a lacuna existente na proteção, segurança e garantia de identidade para as crianças. Durante anos, essa questão crucial tem sido negligenciada, deixando os mais vulneráveis expostos a riscos e sem o reconhecimento adequado. Através da coleta de biometria desde os primeiros momentos de vida, asseguramos que cada criança tenha sua identidade e cidadania protegidas, contribuindo para um futuro mais seguro e inclusivo, onde todas as crianças sejam vistas, cuidadas, respeitadas e tenham pleno acesso aos seus direitos desde o nascimento.

O projeto visa melhorar a qualificação de imagens e a extração de características das impressões digitais, além de permitir o reconhecimento de indivíduos ao longo do tempo, considerando as variações naturais nas características digitais.

Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: Pesquisa da IA Generativa voltada à imagens de impressões digitais de crianças

Principais Atividades:

  • Pesquisa Avançada: Conduzir pesquisas inovadoras em computação quântica aplicadas a sistemas de segurança digital e autenticação biométrica. Explorar novos algoritmos quânticos e suas aplicações práticas na criação de soluções mais robustas e seguras.
  • Desenvolvimento de Soluções: Desenvolver novos modelos de autenticação que utilizem a computação quântica para criar sistemas mais seguros, adaptáveis e imunes a ataques sofisticados.
  • Disseminação do Conhecimento: Participar de conferências e eventos acadêmicos, apresentando descobertas, novas teorias e inovações tecnológicas. Contribuir para a construção de um ecossistema de pesquisa em computação quântica no Brasil e globalmente.
  • Apoio à Implementação de Tecnologias: Auxiliar na transição das descobertas teóricas para a prática, facilitando a implementação de novas tecnologias de segurança digital em ambientes reais, tanto no contexto acadêmico quanto em colaboração com empresas de tecnologia.

Conhecimento necessário:

  • Visão Computacional Avançada
  • Processamento de Sinais e Imagens Digitais
  • Aplicação de redes neurais convolucionais (CNNs)
  • Projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação
  • Programação em Python e C++ com uso de bibliotecas como OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch
  • Atuação com frameworks para prototipagem rápida em visão computacional.
  • Inglês Avançado.

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Programação Quântica: Proficiência em linguagens de programação voltadas para computação quântica, como Qiskit (IBM) e Cirq (Google), além de Python e outras linguagens tradicionais. A capacidade de programar em ambientes quânticos será fundamental para o desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e seguras.
  • Algoritmos Quânticos: Conhecimento avançado na criação, implementação e otimização de algoritmos quânticos, com foco em criptografia quântica e autenticação biométrica. Deve possuir a capacidade de aplicar teoria quântica para criar soluções robustas de segurança digital.
  • Criptografia Quântica: Expertise em criptografia quântica para desenvolver sistemas imunes a ataques futuros, utilizando princípios da física quântica para garantir a segurança da verificação de identidade.
  • Desejável: Conhecimento de algoritmos biométricos e sistemas de verificação de identidade, além de familiaridade com técnicas de deep learning e machine learning aplicadas à biometria.

Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Local: Curitiba/PR

Soft Skills : Trabalho em equipe; Autonomia; Organização.

title: Senior Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

What You'll Do

  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets;
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta;
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry;
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience;
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.

What We Need From You

  • Solid experience in key account management, channel development, or retail management, with a solid foundation in management methodologies and practices.
  • Strong business negotiation and market expansion skills, with a keen ability to identify client and user needs and a proactive attitude toward challenges.
  • Experienced in process and project management, with the ability to drive multiple tasks and projects concurrently.
  • Highly reliable and resilient, demonstrating strong work enthusiasm and a collaborative team spirit.
  • Fluent in English (speaking, reading, and writing) and capable of using it as a working language; proficiency in Portuguese is a strong plus.

Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Assistente de custos
description:
ASSISTENTE DE CUSTOS

Profissional que apoia a área contábil e financeira, responsável por  controlar, analisar e levantar dados sobre despesas, produtos e materiais, elaborando relatórios, planilhas, acompanhando estoques e inventários, e auxiliando na identificação de perdas para  otimizar os gastos da empresa. Ele trabalha com o levantamento de estatísticas de custos de produção, análise de preços, controle de materiais e auxilia na elaboração de orçamentos e demonstrações financeiras, sendo essencial para a gestão eficiente das despesas. 

Principais Funções:

  • Controle de Custos: Elaboração e acompanhamento de planilhas de custos, apontamento de horas e controle de processos produtivos.
  • Análise de Estoques: Conciliação de contas de estoque, administração de inventários (fixos e variáveis) e baixa de insumos.
  • Relatórios: Emissão de relatórios contábeis, de produção e de custos.
  • Orçamentos: Acompanhamento de processos orçamentários e análise de despesas por centro de custo.
  • Interface: Interação com PCP (Planejamento e Controle da Produção) e outras áreas para levantar dados e corrigir falhas.
  • Suporte Contábil: Apoio no registro de atos e fatos contábeis e cálculo de impostos, dependendo da função. 

Qualificações e Habilidades:

  • Formação em áreas como Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou Economia é comum, embora o cargo de auxiliar possa ter requisitos mais flexíveis.
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão, planilhas (Excel) e noções de legislação contábil.
  • Capacidade analítica, organização e atenção aos detalhes são fundamentais. 

O que oferecemos

  • Possibilidade de chegar a ser um Consultor Financeiro
  • Aprendizado prático e estruturado
  • Para lidar com dados financeiros e indicadores
  • Vale transporte e ajuda alimentação

The SAP AMS Project Manager also drives continuous improvement, governance, and customer satisfaction in a global delivery model.

Service & Project Delivery

Manage day-to-day SAP AMS operations, including incident, problem, change, and service request management.

Oversee delivery of SAP enhancements, small projects, and rollouts within agreed timelines and budgets.

Ensure SLAs, KPIs, and service quality targets are consistently achieved.

Coordinate with SAP Basis, Functional, and Technical teams to resolve issues and deliver solutions.

Drive root cause analysis and preventive measures to reduce recurring incidents.

Stakeholder & Client Management

Act as the primary contact for clients regarding SAP AMS delivery.

Facilitate regular status, governance, and steering committee meetings.

Build and maintain strong business stakeholder relationships across Finance, Supply Chain, and other SAP domains.

Translate business priorities into SAP AMS delivery plans.

Allocate resources and track performance of functional and technical consultants.

Collaborate with third-party vendors for specialized SAP services (e.g., Cloud, S/4HANA, integrations).

Governance, Reporting & Financials

Track AMS budgets, contract compliance, and cost optimization initiatives.

Identify and escalate risks/issues with mitigation strategies.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Drive adoption of ITIL best practices, Agile, or DevOps in SAP AMS delivery.

Qualifications & Skills

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business, or related field.

7+ years of experience in SAP project/AMS management.

Strong knowledge of SAP modules (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, etc.) and integration points.

Experience with ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change, Release Management).

Proven track record in managing global/onshore-offshore delivery models.

Excellent client-facing and stakeholder management skills.

PMP, ITIL, or SAP certifications (SAP Solution Manager, Activate, S/4HANA) preferred.

Key Competencies

Deep understanding of SAP AMS operating model.

Strong leadership and team coordination skills.

Analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making ability.

Customer-first mindset with service excellence orientation.

title: Barbeiro
description: Realize atendimentos de lavagem de cabelos, escova lisa, escova modelada e babyliss pela empresa Bluma. É preciso seguir os padrões de qualidade, higiene e biossegurança definidos pela Bluma. Também é esperado que mantenha postura profissional, pontualidade e bom relacionamento com a equipe e com o público atendido. Todos os materiais necessários para os atendimentos, assim como o uniforme completo, serão disponibilizados pela Bluma. Caso o(a) candidato(a) ainda não tenha MEI, a empresa oferece apoio na abertura. Candidatos(as) com MEI pendente ou irregular serão desclassificados(as). É importante também não estar vinculada a benefícios sociais, como Bolsa Família, BPC ou similares, já que a formalização como MEI implica na perda desses benefícios.

Role reports to: Sr. Manager: Automation & AI Platforms
Location: Sao Paulo/Brazil
Travel %: 10%
What you will do
The Intelligent Automation Sr. Engineer is responsible for ensuring continuity and continuous improvement in information management systems, developing and implementing technology platforms to improve efficiency, identifying and overseeing new projects, and presenting progress reports to management and business partners. The role is responsible for building, supporting, and evolving Intelligent Automation technology to accelerate Kenvue's digital ambitions to automate work across the organization.
This role will primarily focus on providing expertise and leadership in maintaining & expanding the Intelligent Process Automation technology offering, deepening the value proposition beyond RPA through leverage of adjacent capabilities such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, Communications Mining, Intelligent Document Processing, Natural Language Processing, Process Mining, Task Mining, etc. In addition, this role will also be responsible for standardization, governance, and compliance across the Enterprise.
Strong communication skills, hands-on experience deploying & managing Intelligent Automation technologies, working knowledge of IT security standards and agile methodologies are a must.
Key Responsibilities
  • A critical point of contact for IT to IT delivery & support team, connecting various IT teams to achieve objectives (local, regional and global)
  • Manage the team's capacity and resource allocations based on priorities and task complexity
  • Train and mentor team members on platform technologies, emerging trends, and career planning
  • Developing Process Automation Models: Including RPA, Process Mining, Task Mining, and Generative AI.
  • Automation Lifecycle Management: Design, development, testing, delivery, and support of automation solutions.
  • Leadership and Management: Lead and manage the design, development, deployment, and quality assurance of automation projects in accordance with Enterprise IA Delivery Methodology.
  • Project Planning and Management: Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and budgets for automation projects.
  • Solution Design Documentation: Responsible for all documentation related to IA projects.
  • Testing Oversight: Ensure adequate stability, reliability, reporting, and exception handling during testing activities.
  • Business Training: Oversee any necessary business training prior to go-live.
  • Deployment Management: Ensure successful deployment of automations into production without impacting existing automations and operations.
  • Compliance and Security: Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and industry standards for automation and security.
  • Support: Provide L2/L3 support for production automations.
  • Technical Design Translation: Translate conceptual 'to-be' business processes into technical designs.
  • Technology Recommendations: Recommend best-fit technology for each automation use case.
  • Standards and Best Practices: Incorporate enterprise standards, other automation best practices, and technical acumen to follow and improve IA Team's development standards.
  • Knowledge Architecture: Act as an architect of knowledge identification and develop an inventory/directory of reusable automation assets.
  • Quality Control: Review automation designs and code development for quality control and adherence to development standards.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify new opportunities for automation or expansion of existing automations.
  • External Trends and Technologies: Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in intelligent automation, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization, including RPA, Cognitive RPA, Open Source Automation, Desktop Automation, AI, and Generative AI.
  • Platform Capability Roadmap: Partner with IA Platform Team and Product teams to ensure the platform capability roadmap evolves to optimally serve the needs of the organization, considering emerging technology.
What we are looking for
Qualifications
· 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing automation solutions
· Strong understanding of Intelligent Automation (Power Platform preferred, Python Automation preferred), Gen AI, Agentic Process Automation, and other emerging automation technologies
· Proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams
· 5+ years of related experience in information technology management.
· University/Bachelors Degree or Equivalent.
· Strong leadership and project management skills.
· Ability to evaluate and recommend software, hardware or services.
· Ability to develop and execute strategies to improve efficiency and productivity.
· Experience with leading automation tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism
· Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
· Experience in business planning activities.
· Ability to manage the design, development, and delivery of project solutions to specified requirements.
What's in it for you
· Competitive Benefit Package*
· Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!
· Learning & Development Opportunities
· Employee Resource Groups
· This list could vary based on location/region
*Note: Total Rewards at Kenvue include salary, bonus (if applicable) and benefits. Your Talent Access Partner will be able to share more about our total rewards offerings and the specific salary range for the relevant location(s) during the recruitment & hiring process.
Kenvue is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.
If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

Strong communication skills, hands-on experience deploying & managing Intelligent Automation technologies, working knowledge of IT security standards and agile methodologies are a must.
Key Responsibilities
  • A critical point of contact for IT to IT delivery & support team, connecting various IT teams to achieve objectives (local, regional and global)
  • Manage the team's capacity and resource allocations based on priorities and task complexity
  • Train and mentor team members on platform technologies, emerging trends, and career planning
  • Developing Process Automation Models: Including RPA, Process Mining, Task Mining, and Generative AI.

This role will primarily focus on providing expertise and leadership in maintaining & expanding the Intelligent Process Automation technology offering, deepening the value proposition beyond RPA through leverage of adjacent capabilities such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, Communications Mining, Intelligent Document Processing, Natural Language Processing, Process Mining, Task Mining, etc. In addition, this role will also be responsible for standardization, governance, and compliance across the Enterprise.
Strong communication skills, hands-on experience deploying & managing Intelligent Automation technologies, working knowledge of IT security standards and agile methodologies are a must.
Key Responsibilities
  • A critical point of contact for IT to IT delivery & support team, connecting various IT teams to achieve objectives (local, regional and global)
  • Manage the team's capacity and resource allocations based on priorities and task complexity
  • Train and mentor team members on platform technologies, emerging trends, and career planning
  • Developing Process Automation Models: Including RPA, Process Mining, Task Mining, and Generative AI.
  • Automation Lifecycle Management: Design, development, testing, delivery, and support of automation solutions.

  • Project Planning and Management: Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and budgets for automation projects.
  • Solution Design Documentation: Responsible for all documentation related to IA projects.
  • Testing Oversight: Ensure adequate stability, reliability, reporting, and exception handling during testing activities.
  • Business Training: Oversee any necessary business training prior to go-live.
  • Deployment Management: Ensure successful deployment of automations into production without impacting existing automations and operations.
  • Compliance and Security: Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and industry standards for automation and security.
  • Support: Provide L2/L3 support for production automations.
  • Technical Design Translation: Translate conceptual 'to-be' business processes into technical designs.
  • Technology Recommendations: Recommend best-fit technology for each automation use case.

Qualifications
· 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing automation solutions
· Strong understanding of Intelligent Automation (Power Platform preferred, Python Automation preferred), Gen AI, Agentic Process Automation, and other emerging automation technologies
· Proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams
· 5+ years of related experience in information technology management.
· University/Bachelors Degree or Equivalent.
· Strong leadership and project management skills.
· Ability to evaluate and recommend software, hardware or services.
· Ability to develop and execute strategies to improve efficiency and productivity.
· Experience with leading automation tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism
· Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
· Experience in business planning activities.
· Ability to manage the design, development, and delivery of project solutions to specified requirements.

Role reports to: Sr. Manager: Automation & AI Platforms
Location: Sao Paulo/Brazil
Travel %: 10%
What you will do
The Intelligent Automation Sr. Engineer is responsible for ensuring continuity and continuous improvement in information management systems, developing and implementing technology platforms to improve efficiency, identifying and overseeing new projects, and presenting progress reports to management and business partners. The role is responsible for building, supporting, and evolving Intelligent Automation technology to accelerate Kenvue's digital ambitions to automate work across the organization.
This role will primarily focus on providing expertise and leadership in maintaining & expanding the Intelligent Process Automation technology offering, deepening the value proposition beyond RPA through leverage of adjacent capabilities such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, Communications Mining, Intelligent Document Processing, Natural Language Processing, Process Mining, Task Mining, etc. In addition, this role will also be responsible for standardization, governance, and compliance across the Enterprise.
Strong communication skills, hands-on experience deploying & managing Intelligent Automation technologies, working knowledge of IT security standards and agile methodologies are a must.
Key Responsibilities
  • A critical point of contact for IT to IT delivery & support team, connecting various IT teams to achieve objectives (local, regional and global)
  • Manage the team's capacity and resource allocations based on priorities and task complexity
  • Train and mentor team members on platform technologies, emerging trends, and career planning
  • Developing Process Automation Models: Including RPA, Process Mining, Task Mining, and Generative AI.
  • Automation Lifecycle Management: Design, development, testing, delivery, and support of automation solutions.
  • Leadership and Management: Lead and manage the design, development, deployment, and quality assurance of automation projects in accordance with Enterprise IA Delivery Methodology.
  • Project Planning and Management: Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and budgets for automation projects.
  • Solution Design Documentation: Responsible for all documentation related to IA projects.
  • Testing Oversight: Ensure adequate stability, reliability, reporting, and exception handling during testing activities.
  • Business Training: Oversee any necessary business training prior to go-live.
  • Deployment Management: Ensure successful deployment of automations into production without impacting existing automations and operations.
  • Compliance and Security: Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and industry standards for automation and security.
  • Support: Provide L2/L3 support for production automations.
  • Technical Design Translation: Translate conceptual 'to-be' business processes into technical designs.
  • Technology Recommendations: Recommend best-fit technology for each automation use case.
  • Standards and Best Practices: Incorporate enterprise standards, other automation best practices, and technical acumen to follow and improve IA Team's development standards.
  • Knowledge Architecture: Act as an architect of knowledge identification and develop an inventory/directory of reusable automation assets.
  • Quality Control: Review automation designs and code development for quality control and adherence to development standards.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify new opportunities for automation or expansion of existing automations.
  • External Trends and Technologies: Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in intelligent automation, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization, including RPA, Cognitive RPA, Open Source Automation, Desktop Automation, AI, and Generative AI.
  • Platform Capability Roadmap: Partner with IA Platform Team and Product teams to ensure the platform capability roadmap evolves to optimally serve the needs of the organization, considering emerging technology.
What we are looking for
Qualifications
· 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing automation solutions
· Strong understanding of Intelligent Automation (Power Platform preferred, Python Automation preferred), Gen AI, Agentic Process Automation, and other emerging automation technologies
· Proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams
· 5+ years of related experience in information technology management.
· University/Bachelors Degree or Equivalent.
· Strong leadership and project management skills.
· Ability to evaluate and recommend software, hardware or services.
· Ability to develop and execute strategies to improve efficiency and productivity.
· Experience with leading automation tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism
· Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
· Experience in business planning activities.
· Ability to manage the design, development, and delivery of project solutions to specified requirements.
What's in it for you
· Competitive Benefit Package*
· Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!
· Learning & Development Opportunities
· Employee Resource Groups
· This list could vary based on location/region

The Intelligent Automation Sr. Engineer is responsible for ensuring continuity and continuous improvement in information management systems, developing and implementing technology platforms to improve efficiency, identifying and overseeing new projects, and presenting progress reports to management and business partners. The role is responsible for building, supporting, and evolving Intelligent Automation technology to accelerate Kenvue's digital ambitions to automate work across the organization.

Key Responsibilities
  • A critical point of contact for IT to IT delivery & support team, connecting various IT teams to achieve objectives (local, regional and global)
  • Manage the team's capacity and resource allocations based on priorities and task complexity
  • Train and mentor team members on platform technologies, emerging trends, and career planning
  • Developing Process Automation Models: Including RPA, Process Mining, Task Mining, and Generative AI.

  • Testing Oversight: Ensure adequate stability, reliability, reporting, and exception handling during testing activities.
  • Business Training: Oversee any necessary business training prior to go-live.

  • Compliance and Security: Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and industry standards for automation and security.
  • Support: Provide L2/L3 support for production automations.
  • Technical Design Translation: Translate conceptual 'to-be' business processes into technical designs.
  • Technology Recommendations: Recommend best-fit technology for each automation use case.
  • Standards and Best Practices: Incorporate enterprise standards, other automation best practices, and technical acumen to follow and improve IA Team's development standards.
  • Knowledge Architecture: Act as an architect of knowledge identification and develop an inventory/directory of reusable automation assets.
  • Quality Control: Review automation designs and code development for quality control and adherence to development standards.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify new opportunities for automation or expansion of existing automations.
  • External Trends and Technologies: Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in intelligent automation, and evaluate their potential impact on the organization, including RPA, Cognitive RPA, Open Source Automation, Desktop Automation, AI, and Generative AI.
  • Platform Capability Roadmap: Partner with IA Platform Team and Product teams to ensure the platform capability roadmap evolves to optimally serve the needs of the organization, considering emerging technology.

Qualifications
· 5+ years of experience in designing and implementing automation solutions
· Strong understanding of Intelligent Automation (Power Platform preferred, Python Automation preferred), Gen AI, Agentic Process Automation, and other emerging automation technologies
· Proven track record of managing and developing high-performing teams

· Ability to evaluate and recommend software, hardware or services.
· Ability to develop and execute strategies to improve efficiency and productivity.
· Experience with leading automation tools such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Blue Prism

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.
At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.
Here is what we offer:

Join Howard University and thrive with us! TITLE:
Perinatal Sonographer
CLASSIFICATION:
Hourly
HOURS OF WORK:
Full Time, 4-day work week
DEPARTMENT:
Maternal Fetal Medicine/Perinatology
REPORTS TO:
Lead Sonographer, Supervising Physician, Clinic Manager
We seek a dedicated professional with expertise in high-risk obstetric imaging who is deeply committed to excellence in maternal-fetal health. The ideal candidate thrives in a collaborative, family-focused environment and values the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient outcomes.
This full-time position offers a four-day work week to support work-life balance while upholding the highest standards of care. Responsibilities include daily sonographic laboratory operations, equipment maintenance and performance, and continuous quality assessment of imaging services. The Perinatal Sonographer upholds strict adherence to Howard University FPP Privacy Policies as well as all applicable federal and state regulations governing healthcare practice and employment.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES
Perform all requested sonographic examinations as ordered by the attending physician. Acquire and analyze data obtained using ultrasound and related diagnostic technologies. Meet examination components as defined by Maternal-Fetal Medicine Division, department procedures, established protocols, and AIUM's examination guidelines.
Greet patients and guests, explain ultrasound procedures, prepare patients for appropriate examination according to department policies. Support patients and their families in a compassionate manner.
Verify accuracy of ultrasound requisition by checking physician orders.
Interview patients to gather history pertinent to the ultrasound examination.
Use independent judgment and systematic problem-solving methods to produce high quality diagnostic information and optimize patient care.
Conduct fetal exams including 1st trimester ultrasound, nuchal translucency measurement, 2nd trimester basic and detailed anatomic survey, 3rd trimester ultrasound, limited examinations, follow up examinations, transvaginal examinations, and biophysical profiles.
Assist perinatologists in invasive procedures such as amniocentesis.
Provide summary findings to the physician to aid patient diagnosis and management. Prepare accurate and comprehensive preliminary reports on the Viewpoint system.
Collaborate closely with maternal-fetal medicine physicians, genetic counselors, nurses, and referring providers to ensure comprehensive care.
Perform portable examinations as requested.
Maintain equipment as instructed. Report equipment failures to the Lead Sonographer.
Perform daily pre-visit planning and assign related clerical duties as required.
Work in accordance with FPP and department policies regarding documentation and billing for ultrasound services.
Responsible for room preparation, stocking, clean-up, and equipment sterilization.
Assume responsibility for the safety and well-being of all patients in the sonographic area/department. Monitor, observe and recognize any abnormal changes in patients' conditions and respond appropriately to emergencies with adequate handoff as needed. Obtaining assistance from physicians and other appropriate staff as needed.
Escort patients to a consultation room or waiting area upon completion of sonographic examination.
Coordinate with other staff to ensure appropriate patient care is provided.
Protect Personal Health Information (PHI) and maintaining compliance with Howard University FPP Privacy Policy. Use the minimum PHI necessary when completing assignments.
Adhere to infection control, safety procedures, and HIPAA compliance.
Promote, establish, and maintain open and effective communication with all members of FPP. Serves as a communication liaison between the physician and the patient.
Participate in continuing education and demonstrate critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Receive, organize, prioritize, store, and maintain transmittable information utilizing electronic technology.
Perform other duties as defined by management or physicians.
EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
Require successful completion of an approved curriculum in diagnostic medical sonography or equivalent educational background.
Current registration (or Registry-eligible) by the American Registry of Diagnostic Medical Sonographers (ARDMS) in Obstetrics and Gynecology.
Prefer one-year prior OB experience or recent internship in obstetrics or MFM clinic. New graduates are welcome to apply.
Basic Life Support and CPR certification are preferred.
Nuchal translucency certification through NTQR or Fetal Maternal Foundation. The ability to obtain certification within 6 months of employment is required if not currently certified.
COMPETENCIES
Exceptional organizational and time management skills to ensure maximum productivity and efficiency.
Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
Ability to work with limited supervision while performing duties.
Meet national matrix standards to ensure the provision of high-quality patient care and diagnostic imaging services.
WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS
This job is operated in a professional medical office environment. Requires the ability to work in a fast-paced environment under pressure and with a diverse population including staff, physicians, patients, family, and other members of the public on a regular basis. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, and fax machines. This position will have frequent exposure to contagious diseases; bodily fluids including blood; toxic substances; medicinal preparations and other conditions common to a clinical environment.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure
Expected Pay Range: $118,18 - $130,000

Join Howard University and thrive with us! BASIC FUNCTION:
The purpose of this position is to provide legal representation on behalf of the University in a variety of matters related to development, fundraising, taxation, and philanthropic activities.
SUPERVISORY ACCOUNTABILITY:
N/A
NATURE AND SCOPE:
Internal contacts include a variety of University officials, the Vice President for Development and Alumni Relations, Academic Deans and Directors, the Chief Financial Officer, the Chief Administrative Officer, and other key stakeholders. External contacts include alumni, individual and corporate donors, and various contacts from educational organizations.
PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:
Offer advice and counsel on a wide range of matters and issues related to the endowment, restricted gifts, taxation, and real estate. Work closely on these matters with the Offices of Development & Alumni Relations, Real Estate and Finance.
Draft gift agreements, structure and negotiate capital, endowed, and planned gifts and gifts of non-marketable assets.
Counsel on pertinent tax issues and reporting obligations, administer testamentary gifts from trusts and estates, and advise on fundraising initiatives and the administration of the University's gift planning programs.
Advise on endowment laws and administration, restricted funds analysis and use, cy pres issues, taxation, investments, related business transactions, fiduciary issues and stewardship matters.
Counsel and assist Office of Human Resources with pension and 403b committee matters.
Review claims and matters that may become legal claims and prepare related correspondence.
Prepare and supervise preparation of legal documents such as pleadings, dispositive motions, responses to charges and information requests, agreements, opinions and advisory memoranda.
Provide general counseling and advice on all issues relating to taxation as it pertains to any aspect of the University.
Independently represent the University in legal quasi-legal proceedings, including the District of Columbia courts and the federal courts having jurisdiction over District of Columbia matters. Also, may represent the University in hearings, meetings, and other forums related to University legal matters.
Draft and negotiate, for subsequent approval by University officers, commitments involving University resources, principally settlements of claims, other agreements and statements of University policy. Reviews documents for other University offices for legal implications and possible legal policy questions.
Respond to University officials' requests for advice in areas of responsibility. Also serve as office resource on current status of law and emerging legal developments in these areas.
Provide legal expertise and otherwise represents the office in meetings with University officials and individuals outside the University.
Stay informed on new and emerging legal issues and regulations on all matters relating to taxation, gifts, donations, or other relevant issues that face a major educational institution.
Performs other job-related duties as assigned.
CORE COMPETENCIES:
Ability to counsel on pertinent tax issues and reporting obligations, administer testamentary gifts from trusts and estates, and advise on fundraising initiatives and the administration of the University's gift planning programs.
Ability to review contracts for accuracy, legal sufficiency and compliance with applicable laws.
Ability to plan, direct and conduct independent legal research and related analyses on a variety of legal issues.
Ability to write lucid, persuasive, properly substantiated legal documents and to strengthen such skills in others.
Ability to argue, listen and negotiate effectively.
Superior verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to draft, review, revise and edit documents in Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Ability to identify possible need for action and to plan, supervise, and execute appropriate assignments with minimal guidance or supervision.
Ability to work productively under pressure, to adhere to and enforce deadlines, and to project need for and effectuate team efforts required to meet deadlines.
Ability to follow guidance and direction and to provide effective guidance and direction.
Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, University officials, and the general public.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and five years of post J.D. legal experience, which include at least three years of substantial gift, taxation and/or nonprofit experience. Strong academic record; excellent oral and written communication skills. Membership or eligibility for membership in the District of Columbia Bar.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure
$172,800

title: Analista Comercial Jr - Uruaçu/GO
description:
A CHS Inc. é uma empresa líder no setor do agronegócio global, de propriedade de fazendeiros, rancheiros e cooperativas em todo o território dos Estados Unidos, e que fornece grãos, alimentos e recursos de energia para empresas e clientes em todo o mundo. Atendemos agricultores e clientes em todo o território dos Estados Unidos e por todo o mundo. A maior parte dos nossos 10.000 funcionários trabalha nos Estados Unidos, mas hoje nós temos funcionários trabalhando em 19 países. Na CHS, estamos criando conexões para fortalecer a agricultura.
Buscamos candidatos capacitados e interessados em contribuir e agregar valor à equipe Comercial na CHS Brasil. A posição de Analista Comercial Jr ficará baseada em Uruaçu/GO.
Propósito do Cargo:
Atuar como suporte ao time de vendas, garantindo fluidez em todo o ciclo comercial: atendimento ao
cliente, elaboração e inclusão de propostas, acompanhamento de cadastros e fluxos de crédito, conferência de sustentabilidade, formalização de garantias, liberações de faturamento e programações de entrega, até o efetivo recebimento financeiro. O cargo tem como objetivo melhorar a experiência do cliente, assegurar governança nos processos e apoiar a eficiência da gestão comercial, liberando o time de vendas para foco em relacionamento, manutenção da carteira e prospecção de novos negócios. Garantir fluidez e governança em todo o ciclo comercial – da proposta ao recebimento – melhorando a experiência do cliente e apoiando a eficiência do time de vendas.
Principais Responsabilidades:
Proatividade comercial, bom atendimento, gerar relacionamento, boa comunicação e foco em resultado.
Apoiar a gestão da carteira de clientes (novos, recorrentes e potenciais).
Garantir fluidez entre Comercial Cliente, Crédito, Sustentabilidade, Logística, fábrica CHS melhorando a experiência do cliente.
Atuar como ponto focal de demandas internas e externas. Montar propostas, registrar nos sistemas e acompanhar
(Agrométrica, D-365, E-mail, outros).
Acompanhar pendências de crédito e liberações de faturamento.
Controlar e organizar fluxos cartoriais (CPRs, certidões, registros) - em conjunto com credito.
Atuar como elo para os recebimentos das vendas (a vista/prazo/sacas e/ou via cessão de credito - fluxos de assinaturas
até a baixa em sist, apoio adv).
Antecipar pedidos de BAIXAS e envio ao produtor.
Alimentar-Atuar em relatórios de vendas, entregas e programações em Power BI. Realizar levantamento de demandas, foco
comercial, por ciclo, da semana, etc. (insumos e grãos).
Monitorar SLAs e atuar como auditor dos processos. Apoiar documentação, assinaturas, formalizações, buscando a aderência com as janelas de entrega de insumos.
O que esperamos de você :
Ensino Superior ou Técnico em Agronomia;
Pacote Office intermediário/avançado;
CNH categoria B;
Residir na região de Uruaçu/GO;

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff "for fit" makes significant contributions to Howard University's overall mission.

Join Howard University and thrive with us! BASIC FUNCTION:
The Collections Counselor supports students with aging or past-due balances by providing clear, accurate, and compassionate financial guidance. The role conducts proactive outreach, explains payment options, resolves discrepancies, documents activity thoroughly, and collaborates with campus partners to help students regain good financial standing. The position ensures all counseling and communications align with university policies, federal regulations, and service quality standards.
SUPERVISORY ACCOUNTABILITY:
None
NATURE AND SCOPE:
The Collections Counselor serves as a frontline financial support specialist within Student Accounts, working directly with students whose balances require follow-up or repayment. The Counselor communicates regularly via phone, email, ticketing, and in-person appointments— occasionally during nontraditional hours—to explain account status, payment plans, holds, and next steps. The role requires strong communication skills, customer-service orientation, attention to detail, and the ability to support adult and traditional learners navigating financial challenges. The incumbent works closely with Collections Leads, Student Accounts Advisors, Cashiering Services, Financial Aid, the Registrar's Office, Treasury, and other campus partners to resolve discrepancies, verify adjustments, and support the timely and accurate processing of payments. The Counselor reinforces university expectations while maintaining a student-centered, empathetic approach.
PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:
Conduct outreach to students with past-due balances to explain account status, payment requirements, repayment options, and consequences of nonpayment.
Provide empathetic, student-centered counseling on payment plans, outstanding charges, financial holds, and available resources.
Assist students with setting up, monitoring, and understanding payment plan terms, deadlines, and consequences for missed payments.
Conduct thorough account reviews, identify discrepancies, and escalate complex or unusual cases to the Collections Lead.
Process returned payments, verify financial adjustments, and coordinate with Financial Aid, Registrar, and Cashiering to ensure accurate account updates.
Maintain detailed documentation of all outreach, counseling sessions, follow-up actions, and resolutions in accordance with departmental policy.
Ensure compliance with FERPA, FDCPA, institutional procedures, and established scripts and communication standards.
Prepare routine reports and status updates to support monitoring of aging balances and collection activities.
Provide high-quality, professional customer service and reinforce university policy while helping students work toward financial stability.
CORE COMPETENCIES:
Demonstrates empathy, patience, and clarity when helping students in financial distress.
Accurately interprets account activity and identifies appropriate next steps.
Communicates clearly and concisely across phone, email, ticketing, and in-person interactions.
Works collaboratively with cross-campus partners to resolve issues efficiently.
Maintains accuracy in account reviews, documentation, and follow-through.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and supporting evening or nontraditional service hours.
Understands billing, collections, payment plan structures, financial aid interactions, and registration impacts.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
Bachelor's degree preferred; an equivalent combination of education and related experience may be considered.
Basic understanding of accounts receivable processess.
One to two years of experience in customer service, billing, student accounts, accounts receivable, financial aid, or another financial operations role.
Experience supporting adult learners or students facing financial hardship preferred.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts clearly and empathetically.
Ability to handle confidential information and comply with FERPA, FDCPA, and institutional guidelines.
Demonstrated ability to analyze account data, identify discrepancies, and escalate complex issues appropriately.
Experience with ERP or student information systems (Workday preferred; training provided).
Proven ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-up tasks in a high-volume environment.
Ability to collaborate effectively with Financial Aid, Cashiering, Registrar, Treasury, and other campus partners.
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure
Expected Salary Range:
$63,000 - $70,000

social media platforms, influencers, media, and the public.

Identify and execute strategies to build Howard University's visibility and enhance its reputation through innovative use of social platforms.
Create and maintain comprehensive social media calendars across flagship channels.

Advanced understanding of major social media platforms, analytics tools, and content formats, with expertise in tailoring content for different audiences.

Skills
Intermediate to Expert-level proficiency in Canva and strong video editing skills for social platforms (Reels, Shorts, TikTok).
Demonstrated ability to design and edit content using professional software (Adobe Premiere, Photoshop, or similar).
Strong writing skills with a clear understanding of audience, tone, nuance, and detail (work in multicultural or higher education highly preferred)
Creative thinking to help conceptualize campaigns and content that inspire audiences and attract media attention.
Strong project management, organization, and reporting skills with a proven ability to juggle multiple deadlines.
Abilities
Ability to work under pressure and consistently meet deadlines, including quick-turn requests.

Demonstrated ability to assess social performance, identify opportunities, and deliver actionable insights.
Initiative and creativity in generating new content ideas and campaign approaches.

Results-oriented, resourceful, and enthusiastic with a proactive, solutions-first approach.

Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Advertising, Public Relations, or a related field.
2–3 years of progressive experience in digital communications, social media management, or online marketing.
Required: high-level to expert proficiency in Canvaand social-native video editing.
Demonstrated ability to work in a high-volume environment and manage multiple projects.

Hands-on experience managing a highly active, high-reach social platform(university, corporate, entertainment, or public figure).
Demonstrated knowledge or high interest of generative AI tools and technologies for content creation.
Intermediate to advanced skills in higher-end editing software (Adobe Premiere or similar).
Experience with social media scheduling software (Meltwater, Sprout, Hootsuite, Loomly, Later, or similar).
Prior social media experience in higher education, large organizations, or public-facing institutions preferred but not required.

description:

Join Howard University and thrive with us! THE OFFICE OF UNDERGRADUATE STUDIES
The Office of Undergraduate Studies (OUS), an established unit within the Office of the Provost, operates with goals to meet and exceed retention, persistence, graduation, and career outcomes noted in the strategic plan. OUS comprises three major units: The Academic Center for Excellence, Center for Career & Professional Success, and the Office of General Education. Collectively, OUS units provide transformative offerings through three major functions: academic excellence support, academic and career exploration, and career development.
BASIC FUNCTION
The Academic and Career Advisor delivers integrated academic and career advising to an assigned caseload of undergraduate students. The advisor supports student persistence, timely progression, graduation, and post-graduate outcomes through proactive advising, data-informed outreach, and high-impact student success practices.
ADVISING SCOPE AND CASELOAD
Manages a defined caseload aligned to an advising cluster (for example FTIC, undecided, pre-professional, or major-based cohorts).
Provides holistic advising that integrates academic planning, major exploration, career readiness, and institutional navigation.
Serves as a consistent point of contact for students from entry through graduation or transition to faculty advising.
PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES
Student Advising and Support
Deliver proactive, student-centered academic and career advising using scheduled appointments, targeted outreach, and early-alert interventions.
Guide students in understanding degree requirements, academic policies, registration processes, and academic standing expectations.
Support students in major exploration, decision-making, and alignment of academic choices with career interests and goals.
Refer students to appropriate campus resources and track follow-through.
Document advising interactions accurately and consistently in the student information system.
Retention, Progression, and Graduation
Monitor academic progress and intervene when students show risk indicators.
Support milestone completion such as major declaration, credit progression, experiential learning engagement, and graduation clearance.
Contribute directly to unit goals related to retention, persistence, and completion.
Career Integration
Integrate career readiness conversations into advising interactions, including skills articulation, experiential learning, and post-graduate planning.
Collaborate with career services partners to support internships, fellowships, graduate school preparation, and workforce outcomes.
Collaboration and Communication
Collaborate with faculty, enrollment management, student success units, and advising colleagues to support consistent student success practices.
Communicate clearly and professionally with students, families, faculty, and staff.
Participate in advising meetings, trainings, and unit initiatives.
Data, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement
Use student data and advising metrics to inform outreach and advising strategies.
Maintain compliance with institutional policies, FERPA, and advising protocols.
Participate in professional development and continuous improvement activities.
Other Duties
Perform other duties as assigned in support of advising operations and student success initiatives.
CORE COMPETENCIES
Commitment to supporting Black students and historically underrepresented populations.
Working knowledge of academic policies, degree requirements, and student success practices in higher education.
Ability to manage complex caseloads and competing priorities.
Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.
Professional judgment, discretion, and emotional regulation.
Ability to work independently while contributing to a team-based advising model.
Comfort using student information systems, advising platforms, and data dashboards.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS
A bachelor's degree is required.
One to three years of experience in academic advising, student success, higher education, or a related field.
Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.
PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS
Master's degree in higher education, counseling, student affairs, or related fields.
Experience with integrated academic and career advising models.
Demonstrated use of data to drive student outreach and outcomes.
Student engagement and responsiveness
Contribution to team goals and advising initiatives
Compliance Salary Range Disclosure
$51,000-$61,000

Join Howard University and thrive with us! A full-time Postdoctoral Research Associate Position will soon be available in the Laboratory of Dr. Sayan Nandi (PI), Howard University, Washington DC. The laboratory (funded by NIH and private foundation grants) is focused on understanding the contributions of microglial cells, the brain-resident macrophages (the principal immune cell type of the brain), toward various brain disorders. Thus, the work focus of the laboratory is at the interface of neuroscience and immunology. The laboratory integrates mouse genetic studies and cell culture model systems, to study the role of microglia, in the contexts of developmental and neuropsychiatric disorders (such as autism, schizophrenia), neurodegenerative diseases (such as Alzheimer's disease, frontotemporal dementia), and neural injury (such as stroke, TBI).
Microglia are the first amongst all macrophages to appear during early embryonic development. Recent studies have placed microglia in the landscape of sculpting and refining neural circuits due to their ability to modify synapses in live neurons, a phenomenon that has strong implications in neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative diseases. These immune cells are also amongst the first responders following a neural injury. The laboratory undertakes multidisciplinary approaches such as biochemistry, molecular biology, cell biology, genetics, genomics, high-resolution imaging, neurophysiology, surgical, and behavioral studies. More information on Dr. Nandi's research is available on:

The candidate is also expected to work collaboratively with the faculty in the Department of Anatomy, College of Medicine, as well as outside the Department, as required. The candidate should be able to effectively communicate with the PI. This position requires in-depth understanding of brain function and scientific literature, extensive data analysis and interpretation, as well as skills required for scientific presentation. NATURE AND SCOPE:

Customs and Border Protection Officer (CBPO)
NEW RECRUITMENT INCENTIVES!
U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) offers those interested in a career in law enforcement an exceptional opportunity to work with an elite team of highly trained professionals whose camaraderie, pride, and purpose are hallmarks of their daily mission of protecting America. You will be part of the Department of Homeland Security workforce, protecting American interests and securing our nation.
If you are looking for a rewarding career with great pay, benefits, and job stability, now is the time to make your move.
DON'T FORGET TO CHECK OUT THE INCENTIVES – SEE SALARY SECTION BELOW
As a Customs and Border Protection Officer (CBPO) , you will be part of our 60,000+ workforce that strives to protect the American people by safeguarding our borders, deterring illicit activity, and enhancing the nation's economic prosperity. Being a CBPO makes you a valuable member of the Federal Law Enforcement Officer (LEO) profession.
Typical assignments include:
Enforcing customs, immigration, and agriculture laws and regulations.
Facilitating the flow of legitimate trade and travel.
Conducting inspections of individuals and conveyances.
Determining the admissibility of individuals for entry into the United States; and
Preventing the illegal entry of individuals and prohibited goods and the smuggling of illegal drugs and other contraband.

Locations offered are based on operational and mission requirements and critical agency hiring needs for entry-level CBPOs as determined by the CBP Office of Field Operations (OFO).
